# @agents-js/canvas-model

> Dependency-free canvas document model helpers for agents-js A2UI payload handoff, OCIF-style preservation, and JSON Canvas preview export.

## Installation

```sh
bun add @agents-js/canvas-model
```

## API

<!-- Auto-generated from JSDoc -->

### Functions

- **`createA2uiCanvasNode`** — Wrap an A2UI payload as a portable agents-js canvas node.
- **`exportJsonCanvas`** — Export agents-js canvas nodes to a JSON Canvas 1.0-compatible preview.
- **`exportOcif`** — Export agents-js canvas nodes to an OCIF-style document that preserves agents-js extensions beside a plain-text preview resource.
- **`toInertJson`** — Convert arbitrary input into inert JSON by dropping executable values and normalizing values such as Date and bigint.

### Interfaces

- **`AgentsA2uiExtension`**
- **`AgentsCanvasNode`** — Portable agents-js canvas node for an inert A2UI payload.
- **`AgentsProvenanceExtension`**
- **`CanvasExportWarning`**
- **`CanvasPoint`**
- **`CanvasSize`**
- **`CreateA2uiCanvasNodeOptions`**
- **`JsonCanvasDocument`**
- **`JsonCanvasExportResult`**
- **`JsonCanvasTextNode`**
- **`OcifDocument`**
- **`OcifNode`**
- **`OcifResource`**
- **`OcifSchemaEntry`**
- **`OcifTextRepresentation`**

### Types

- **`AgentsCanvasExtension`**
- **`CanvasProvenance`** — Provisional canvas provenance payload. Identity remains caller-owned until the agents-js identity contract lands; this package stores it as inert JSON.
- **`JsonObject`**
- **`JsonPrimitive`**
- **`JsonValue`**
